name: I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 3,000 m long and 45 m wide

max_aircraft.v: critical aircraft is the Airbus A380-800 (aerodrome code 4E)

hours.v: airport closed for Nyepi (Balinese Day of Silence): in 2026 from 06:00 local on 19 March to 06:00 local on 20 March (all domestic and international flights stopped); the date changes each year, check the NOTAM
hours.quote: akan dihentikan sementara mulai Kamis, 19 Maret 2026 pukul 06.00 WITA hingga Jumat, 20 Maret 2026 pukul 06.00 WITA.

notes: Indonesian AIP (aimindonesia.dephub.go.id) needs a login and blocks automated access, so no AD 2 data. Facts are from the DGCA (Hubud Kemenhub) airport register, which shows no update date. Coordinates converted from DMS (LS = south, BT = east). 1 Nov 2026: added the Nyepi closure from the Ministry of Transportation news of 15 Mar 2026 (quote in Indonesian; WITA = UTC+8 = local time). The ministry page says all domestic and international flights stop; it names no exceptions. Re-read the DGCA register (hubud.kemenhub.go.id/bandara/11): it still shows 'Runway (-)' with no designation and no hours; operator PT. Angkasa Pura Indonesia; customs, immigration and quarantine offices listed without hours. Could not be opened: https://ngurahrai.injourneyairports.id/ (operator site).
